stories.title: Follow live: Lions, Panthers go head-to-head in Charlotte
NFL looking into official apparently cursing at Cards TE McBride
stories.summary: The NFL says it is reviewing an official's apparent use of profanity directed at Cardinals tight end Trey McBride in Sunday's game against the Giants.

stories.title: More dramatics: Brewers' Chourio masters Padres' Miller for walk-off win
stories.summary: Jackson Chourio hit a two-run single off Padres closer Mason Miller with two outs in the ninth inning as the Brewers rallied past the Padres for a 2-0 NLDS lead.

stories.title: Lamar leaves stadium in boot after hurting ankle in Ravens' win
stories.summary: Lamar Jackson left the Ravens' game against the Titans on Sunday with an ankle injury.

stories.title: Bengals' top WRs Chase, Higgins suffer injuries in loss to Jags
stories.summary: Bengals wide receivers Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins both suffered injuries in Sunday's loss to the Jaguars.
